request.name: Chat.vue - Collapsible for File list and profiles
request.content:
## Issue
File list, profiles, and list in Chat.vue should use Collapsible components with truncation on header and expansion on detail view.

## Requirements
- File list should be collapsible (truncate on header, expand on detail)
- Profiles section should be collapsible
- List items in header should be truncated with expand/collapse functionality
- Show full content when expanded

## Files to Update
- Chat.vue (primary component)
- Review existing Collapsible component usage

## Implementation Notes
- Identify which sections need collapsible behavior
- Define truncation rules (number of items, text length, etc.)
- Ensure smooth expand/collapse animations
- Maintain accessibility standards

request.name: MainMenu - List all apps with single view route
request.content:
## Issue
MainMenu must list all apps and ensure there's a route for the single app view (no desktop view).

## Requirements
- Display all available apps in MainMenu
- Ensure each app has a dedicated single view route
- Remove or bypass desktop view for app navigation
- Make app selection navigate to app-specific view

## Files to Update
- MainMenu component
- Router configuration (routing rules)

## Implementation Notes
- Audit all available apps in the system
- Verify router paths for each app
- Test navigation from MainMenu to app views
- Ensure no desktop view interference
